user.title: Green Mountain Grill
user.description: The grill must be in WiFi Mode, not Server Mode (set in the GMG app) - in Server Mode it does not answer on your network. Optionally enter the grill's IP address (required when the grill is on a different VLAN than Home Assistant - broadcast discovery does not cross subnets). Leave blank for same-subnet broadcast discovery.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

error.no_devices_found: No Green Mountain Grill answered. Check that the grill is in WiFi Mode, not Server Mode (set in the GMG app), that it is powered on, and that it is on the same subnet as Home Assistant - or enter its IP address.
